summary: Audited the four representation-theory claims underpinning the branch's Fortune-crown no-go stack by exact finite computation for p=5,7,11,13. ALL FOUR ARE CONFIRMED. (1) HCE.1: dim V_i^{C_p}=(C(p-1,i)+(p-1)(-1)^i)/p is integral for every i, equals the exact count of i-element subsets of F_p^* summing to 0 mod p (brute-force enumeration), and equals the character-average/generating-function value. (2) The cyclic Adams trace identity Tr(F|e_1 W)-Tr(F|e_zeta W)=Tr(F·tau|W)=Tr(F^p|K) holds to machine precision for random operators; eigenspace dims (r^p+(p-1)r)/p and (r^p-r)/p match and differ by r; and Lambda_p=sum_i(-1)^i wedge^i Std has character = p on p-cycles and 0 on every other class (the p-cycle/irreducibility indicator, = det(1-g|Std)). (3) Even-hook and odd-hook total dimensions are each exactly 2^{p-2}=2^{p-1}/2, and since the hooks are distinct irreducibles this is the forced minimal semisimple positive/negative rank. (4) Each wedge^i Std is irreducible (self inner-product 1), the p distinct i are pairwise orthogonal (distinct irreducibles), and each matches the Murnaghan-Nakayama character of the hook S^{(p-i,1^i)}; distinctness forces Hom(even-sector,odd-sector)=0. The rep-theory layer of the no-go argument is sound. Note this audit covers only the pure representation theory; the local inertia/Swan/GOS inputs and the ultimate 'open' after-pushforward cancellation claim were not in scope.
writeup:
All computations are exact finite checks (sympy/numpy), self-contained; no external literature needed. Script: /home/user/multi-agent-environment/.claude/worktrees/wf_a939e8f4-f79-1/audit_rep/verify.py

ITEM 1 — HCE.1 (dim V_i^{C_p}). For each p in {5,7,11,13} and each i in 0..p-1: (a) the numerator C(p-1,i)+(p-1)(-1)^i is divisible by p (closed form integral); (b) the closed value equals the brute-force count of i-subsets of F_p^* whose elements sum to 0 mod p; (c) it equals the character-average value, i.e. the coefficient extraction from (1/p)[(1+t)^{p-1} + (p-1)·sum_j(-1)^j t^j], which is the branch's generating-function derivation (identity element gives (1+t)^{p-1}; each nonidentity C_p element gives prod_{r=1}^{p-1}(1+t·zeta^r)=(1+t^p)/(1+t)=sum(-1)^i t^i). Example p=5 row (i,closed,enum,gf): (0,1,1,1),(1,0,0,0),(2,2,2,2),(3,0,0,0),(4,1,1,1). All three agree for all i, all p. CONFIRMED.

ITEM 2 — Cyclic Adams class (CAF.1). Built W=K^{⊗p} with tau the cyclic shift of tensor factors, projectors e_1=(1/p)Σtau^k and e_zeta=(1/p)Σzeta^{-k}tau^k, and F=F0^{⊗p} for a random 3x3 complex F0. For p=5,7: |Tr(F|e_1 W) − Tr(F|e_zeta W) − Tr(F·tau|W)| = 0 and |Tr(F·tau|W) − Tr(F0^p|K)| = 0 (machine precision). So [e_1 W]−[e_zeta W] realizes psi^p at trace level exactly as claimed. Eigenspace dimensions: dim e_1 = (r^p+(p-1)r)/p and dim e_zeta = (r^p−r)/p matched the actual projector traces (p=5: 51,48; p=7: 315,312), difference = r as stated. The irreducibility-character claim Lambda_p = psi^p − K is corroborated by Item 3's finding that Lambda_p = Σ(−1)^i wedge^i Std has character equal to det(1−g|Std) = p on p-cycles and 0 on all other classes — exactly the p-cycle (=irreducibility of X^p+aX^3+cX+d) indicator, scaled by p. CONFIRMED.

ITEM 3 — Effectivity lower bound (CAF.4). Σ_{i even} C(p-1,i) = Σ_{i odd} C(p-1,i) = 2^{p-2} for all four primes (8,8 / 32,32 / 512,512 / 2048,2048), i.e. each equals 2^{p-1}/2. Because the p hooks are pairwise distinct irreducibles (Item 4), the only semisimple E^+,E^- with [E^+]−[E^-]=Lambda_p after cancelling common constituents are E^+=⊕_{i even}wedge^i Std, E^-=⊕_{i odd}wedge^i Std; hence minimum positive rank = minimum negative rank = 2^{p-2}. The virtual (alternating) dimension is (1−1)^{p-1}=0 while each semisimple part is exponential — the exact obstruction the branch asserts. CONFIRMED.

ITEM 4 — Hooks distinct irreducibles = S^{(p-i,1^i)}. Computing the character of wedge^i Std as e_i of the Std eigenvalues per conjugacy class: (a) <chi_i,chi_i>=1 for every i (irreducible); (b) <chi_i,chi_j>=0 for all i≠j (pairwise distinct, hence pairwise non-isomorphic); (c) chi_i matches the Murnaghan-Nakayama character of the hook partition (p−i,1^i) on every cycle type. Since the even-sector constituents {S^{(p-i,1^i)}: i even} and odd-sector {i odd} are disjoint sets of distinct irreducibles, Schur's lemma gives Hom_{S_p}(even-sector, odd-sector)=0 — no nonzero equivariant parity-reversing map before pushforward, as claimed. CONFIRMED.

Scope caveat: this audit verifies the pure S_p / C_p representation-theoretic content only. The inputs it takes on faith (the fixed-q local inertia I_∞=C_p⋊C_{(p-1)/2}, single lower jump (p-3)/2, the GOS Euler-characteristic bookkeeping) and the branch's ultimately-open after-pushforward Frobenius-cancellation statement were not part of this representation-theory task and are not adjudicated here.
